title: Fixed Side Press Basket and Wheeled Cleaning Bucket
description: One newly authored complete static side-press wringer-bucket appearance for commercial cleaning. A thick chamfered open deep bucket stands on four small caster assemblies with real forks and axles. Two rim brackets carry a genuinely open-topped, through-slotted raised wringer basket with finite bottom openings. A separate fixed pressure plate inside the basket joins a transverse shaft and long raised side lever with a full grip. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, one prop and zero scenes. No mop, cloth, water, fluid simulation, squeezing action, pressure, capacity, cleaning performance, instructions, stability/load or safety claim. Newly authored complete geometry, not the brush-wash basin or two-roll cloth wringer resized. Basket slots exist in actual geometry; the internal plate occludes some assembled sight lines.
